c6642c7673af: A return is the clearer request when the item does not match the order, a visible condition problem crosses your threshold, or a missing component makes the product unusable for its intended purpose. Confirm that the live order offers the action before relying on it. Record any displayed domestic return freight, deductions or seller conditions as separate cost fields rather than subtracting an assumed amount from the product price.
1cea62351686: Choose an exchange only when the replacement is specific
6a98b398e35d: An exchange adds another seller dispatch and warehouse cycle. It makes sense when you can name the correct replacement option, the seller appears able to supply it, and the additional time and domestic movement are acceptable. Freeze the failed item's evidence, then create a fresh record for the replacement. Do not overwrite the original size or colour; otherwise the history may make the first shipment look correct.
c0e24600af85: Ship only when the remaining uncertainty is acceptable
7f35dc76c4c4: Shipping can be rational when the item identity is correct, the concern is minor or expected variation, and the cost or uncertainty of after-sale action outweighs the visible issue. Approval should be explicit. Write what you accepted and why. International shipping usually makes a warehouse-stage seller remedy harder to pursue, so “ship now and decide later” is not a neutral option.
71db7d0ae4a3: State the agent order ID and warehouse item ID.
3f80cd615735: Copy the exact ordered option and quantity from the purchase record.
0cd56a3eaf50: Describe one observable mismatch in a single sentence.
469090215a0c: Attach or identify a wide QC view that proves item identity.
4c10137ade89: Add the closest relevant view without hiding surrounding context.
b8c1cce35fe7: Name one requested outcome: additional evidence, exchange, return or clarification of eligibility.
6153435c12be: Record the request date and preserve every later response or status change.
bbd1f887f4c2: Keep the packet proportional. Ten screenshots of the same mark do not replace one image that links the mark to the right item. Do not include payment credentials, private messages unrelated to the case, other customers' orders or your international address. Evidence should identify the order and the problem while minimizing unnecessary personal information.
3d9293f9cc76: After-sale decisions can involve more than the product amount. Potential fields include domestic return freight, seller-approved refund, an exchange price difference, agent-side service amounts shown in the live interface and the cost of requested evidence. Record a value only when it appears in your specific order or is confirmed for that action. Unknown is not zero.
b569a5806cd8: Use three columns: quoted, confirmed and settled. A quoted refund is not settled money, and an approved exchange is not a replacement received at the warehouse. Keep account-balance movements separate from payment-method settlement. This prevents a pending amount from being counted as available for the next order.
e9fbf8f775ce: Follow the replacement or refund to completion
0f1c6b45b9d7: For a return, record the status that shows the item left the warehouse, any domestic tracking made available, seller receipt where visible, the approved amount and the final settlement record. For an exchange, continue until the replacement has a distinct order or warehouse identity and its own QC review. The process is not complete merely because the original item disappeared from the active storage view.
1048b3440ab8: If the status stops changing, ask about the specific missing handoff. “Has the seller received this domestic return?” is better than “Where is my refund?” when receipt is not yet established. “Which transaction records the settled amount?” is better after approval. A narrow question lets support locate the stage without reconstructing the entire order from a vague message.
61b0682dbaad: The public material reviewed for this guide confirms that HooBuy presents returns, refunds, inspection and warehouse after-sale as support categories. It does not establish that every seller, marketplace listing, custom item or preference change has the same eligibility, deadline, cost or remedy. Those details must come from the live order and the applicable seller terms.
874206f8729f: The practical advantage of an evidence-first return is not a guaranteed refund. It is a cleaner decision. You preserve the ordered state, identify the observable difference, ask for the correct action and track the next handoff. That approach helps you avoid paying international freight for an unresolved item while also avoiding exaggerated claims that the warehouse photos cannot prove.

d28548a958e7: Hoobuy seller sent but warehouse not received
de1b261cd7d3: status is a handoff problem, not a single countdown. The seller may have created a domestic tracking number, physically transferred a parcel, split one order into several packages, or entered a number that does not yet identify a carrier scan. At the receiving end, a delivery event may still need to be matched to an order and converted into a warehouse item record. Each stage produces different evidence.
4668470633c5: The quickest route to a useful answer is to reconstruct the domestic chain in order. This guide explains how to separate a seller statement from carrier custody, match every package to the correct order, and prepare a focused record if the expected warehouse intake has not appeared. It does not assign a universal delay threshold because seller processing, domestic carriers, package splits and warehouse intake conditions can vary.
5f7499697401: Start with the exact order record
18f31178db40: Open the relevant order rather than relying on a dashboard summary. Copy the order ID, listing title, selected color or size, quantity, seller name if displayed, current status text and the time attached to the latest change. Save the product source URL separately. If several orders contain similar items, the variant and quantity are often the fastest way to prevent one package from being attributed to another.
ff453386c07b: HooBuy’s public help center treats shopping-agent order status, seller delivery and Chinese domestic delivery as separate help topics. That separation is useful: an order can progress in the purchasing system before a physical parcel is visible in a carrier system. Record what the interface actually shows and avoid translating “sent” into “received.”
95eef39e544b: Test whether the seller actually handed over a parcel
971780e66fc4: A domestic number is an identifier, not proof of movement. Check whether the carrier record contains an acceptance or collection scan. Electronic information, label creation or a seller-provided number can appear before carrier custody. If the record has no physical scan, the unresolved handoff is still between seller and carrier. If an acceptance scan exists, the custody trail has moved to the domestic network.
8bf7c7b6b2af: Copy the full number without spaces added by a messaging app. Note the carrier name, first physical event, event time, latest event and location. Do not paste addresses or phone numbers into a public document. A private worksheet containing identifiers and event timestamps is enough for matching.
03fcc1f91a4c: One marketplace order does not always equal one domestic package. A seller can dispatch available items separately, use more than one warehouse, or put several line items into one parcel. Build a package-count field beside every order. If the seller shows two tracking numbers, create two rows even when the buying interface uses one order ID.
7c92e6922d84: The opposite pattern also occurs: several items can share one number. In that case, keep a manifest of the expected contents and quantities. When the warehouse creates item records later, compare the received set with that manifest. Package count explains many apparent gaps that cannot be solved by repeatedly checking a single order badge.
2caaf5d84d36: Read the last domestic carrier event precisely
ee37d3206851: The evidence supports a seller-to-carrier gap. Preserve the number and the time it was added, then ask for confirmation of physical dispatch or a corrected identifier. Do not state that the carrier lost a parcel it never recorded receiving.
81bd675ae352: The carrier controls the current stage. Record the latest facility and event. A platform warehouse cannot create an intake record before the domestic parcel reaches the receiving location, so a warehouse request is premature unless the carrier evidence conflicts with the platform.
797fbff82e74: Delivery proves a carrier-reported endpoint, not automatic warehouse storage. Save the delivery location, timestamp, proof or recipient code if the carrier provides one, and the package count. The next investigation is a delivery-to-intake match.
ab92cb1f00ec: Match delivery to the correct warehouse intake
22f8b002ffd6: Compare the destination details available in the order with the carrier’s delivered location. For a forwarding order, confirm that the seller used the exact warehouse address and required recipient or identification code recorded when the order was created. For a shopping-agent order, use the platform order ID and domestic number shown in the account rather than guessing an address from another order.
460aa1a56d67: Warehouse intake may create a new item-level identifier. Keep the old domestic tracking number connected to that new ID. If the delivered parcel contained several items, list which item records appeared and which did not. This turns “nothing was stored” into a precise reconciliation request such as “package D shows delivered; two of three expected item records exist; the blue size-L item is unmatched.”
7d9068b3f397: Build an evidence table before contacting support
55858871fc3e: order ID, exact variant, quantity and source URL.
7fbf9247ed0a: status text and the time the domestic number appeared.
782aebff2cfe: carrier name, first physical scan and latest event.
96ae1a67c122: every number and the expected contents of each package.
f949c0f4432f: time, location and any non-sensitive proof provided by the carrier.
1f11c256b834: item IDs already created and the exact missing item or package.
db446dfc0818: confirm dispatch, correct the number, match a delivery or identify the next required record.
faec813fd639: Use timestamped screenshots or exports, but hide unrelated names, addresses, balances and phone numbers. Keep the event text visible. A screenshot cropped to one green badge without the identifier and time is difficult to investigate.
74f4833d1144: Escalate to the party controlling the first missing handoff
578fbd38633c: If there is no carrier acceptance, the first missing handoff is seller to carrier. If the carrier is moving the parcel, the evidence remains in domestic tracking. If the carrier shows delivery but no matching warehouse record exists, the first missing handoff is receiving and intake. The responsible stage is determined by evidence, not by which page is easiest to message.
